brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished two homes belonging to the al-Ja'ba family in Hebron city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolitions were documented in footage showing the moment of detonation at the family residences.

The incident marks another instance of home demolitions in the occupied West Bank, a practice that Palestinian rights groups say amounts to collective punishment and a violation of international law.
title: Israeli forces demolish two homes of al-Ja'ba family in Hebron
